verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents a first-party connector system: connectors are installed as plugins from Marketplace (docs-30), and the Bot can also operate browser-based services that lack a dedicated connector (docs-13). It also shows email integration through editable send-email drafts (docs-26). The evidence never names cloud-drive, email, or calendar connectors, and never shows the Bot searching those sources to ground its answers. Missing for 10: named cloud drive, email and calendar connectors, documented search/retrieval over connected content in answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
